notes.subject: mmolodi
notes.rationale: mmolodi wa lewatle = maleme a metsi a boima go ralala go lewatle (mmolodi ke 'tongue' — sebopego se sengwe sa metsi)

notes.subject: בעים
notes.rationale: hapax: 'ka maatla' (kojene) vs 'o makatšago/mosesane' — barometri ba fapana

notes.subject: בעים
notes.rationale: lentšu le hwetšwa fela mo go Tanakh

notes.subject: נחלים / בנעלים
notes.rationale: sebopego sa mantswe a swanago (nachalim / ne'alim) — boitshwaro bjo bo se nago mo Sepeding

notes.subject: tše šupa
notes.rationale: go bala dipitsa tše šupa — palo ya botlalo

translation: Gomme Yahwe o tla phunya ⟨את⟩ mmolodi wa lewatle la Mitsrayime, gomme o tla nyakolla seatla sa gagwe godimo ga noka ka maatla a moya wa gagwe o makatšago, gomme o tla e kgoba go ba dipitsa tše šupa, gomme o tla dumeša batho go e ralala ka dieta.

tokens.gloss: gomme o tla dumeša batho go ralala
